attributionNotes: Provider names, model identifiers and documentation links in the upstream baseline are derived from the open models.dev catalog (MIT).
Floe curates, filters and maps the data to its own provider kinds, protocols and auth styles.
No upstream code, JS SDK content, API keys or user credentials are copied.
Merged upstream ids are listed in each provider's upstreamIDs field.

Official Google Gemini conversation candidates, Volcengine Agent Plan / Alibaba Token Plan entries and patched PAYG media rows are first-party Floe review facts declared in curated-overrides.json; they are not models.dev content.

curatedOverrides.note: Official conversation, plan and PAYG media entries come from first-party Floe review, not models.dev. The models.dev documentSHA256 pin covers the upstream baseline only.

pinPolicy: canonical pin is documentSHA256 of the served api.json; the recorded repository revision is informational and not assumed byte-identical to the served response
